title: OwnershipInterest
description: Links a person or organization to a strata lot as a registered owner for a period of time.
x-validationRules: endDate must be on or after startDate.
partyId must reference a Person when partyType is person, and an Organization otherwise.
x-legalReviewNotes: Ownership is established by the Land Title register. Records in this standard are informational copies, not proof of title.

id.description: Stable identifier of this OwnershipInterest record.

partyType.description: Kind of party that holds the interest.

partyId.description: Identifier of the Person or Organization, according to partyType.

startDate.description: Date the ownership began (for example, registration date).

endDate.description: Date the ownership ended, if it has.

extensions.description: Implementation-specific data, namespaced by reverse domain.
